record.context_brief: boundedness of type in almost symmetric semigroups
record.original_question: For each positive integer e, let A(e) be the supremum of the type t(Gamma) over almost symmetric numerical semigroups Gamma with embedding dimension e. Is A(e) finite for every e?

evidence.quote: Problem 19 ([M16, Question 13]). Is A (e) < ∞ for every e ∈ N?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A numerical semigroup is a subset $\Gamma \subseteq \mathbb{N} = \{0,1,2,\dots\}$ that contains $0$, is closed under addition, and has finite complement in $\mathbb{N}$. The Frobenius number $F(\Gamma)$ is the largest integer not in $\Gamma$. The set of pseudo-Frobenius numbers is
$$\mathrm{PF}(\Gamma) = \{x \in \mathbb{Z}\setminus\Gamma : x + \gamma \in \Gamma \text{ for all } \gamma \in \Gamma\setminus\{0\}\},$$
and the type of $\Gamma$ is $t(\Gamma) = |\mathrm{PF}(\Gamma)|$. The semigroup $\Gamma$ is called almost symmetric if for every $x \in \mathrm{PF}(\Gamma)$ one has $F(\Gamma) - x \in \mathrm{PF}(\Gamma)$ (equivalently, if $2g(\Gamma) = F(\Gamma) + t(\Gamma)$, where $g(\Gamma)$ is the number of gaps). The embedding dimension $e(\Gamma)$ is the cardinality of the unique minimal system of generators of $\Gamma$.

For each positive integer $e$, define
$$A(e) = \sup\{\, t(\Gamma) : \Gamma \text{ is an almost symmetric numerical semigroup with } e(\Gamma) = e\,\}.$$

Determine whether $A(e) < \infty$ for every $e \in \mathbb{N}$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether the type of an almost symmetric numerical semigroup is bounded in terms of the embedding dimension appears to remain open in general. It is known classically that $A(e) \le e-1$ holds and bounds are obtained for small embedding dimensions (e.g., $e=4$ where the type is at most $3$, and partial results in $e=5$), but no general finiteness proof of $A(e)$ for all $e$ has been published.

status_evidence.title: Nearly Gorenstein and almost symmetric properties in shifted numerical semigroups
status_evidence.snippet: the type of nearly Gorenstein numerical semigroups minimally generated by 5 integers is bounded; in particular, if such a semigroup is not almost symmetric, then its type is at most 40
status_evidence.claim: Bounds on type are obtained only for specific small embedding dimensions, indicating the general boundedness problem is still under investigation.

status_evidence.title: Almost symmetric numerical semigroups
status_evidence.snippet: Almost symmetric numerical semigroups and their structure via row-factorization matrices.
status_evidence.claim: Research on the structure of almost symmetric numerical semigroups continues, supporting the open status of the general type-boundedness question.

status_evidence.title: Bounds for invariants of numerical semigroups and Wilf's conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Bounds for the type of numerical semigroups as a function of embedding dimension and multiplicity.
status_evidence.claim: Type bounds in terms of embedding dimension and multiplicity are studied, but a uniform bound depending only on embedding dimension for almost symmetric semigroups is not established in general.
